business_model.narrative_summary: Shilchar manufactures various types of transformers including power, distribution, renewable energy, furnace, converter duty, and earthing & isolation transformers, specializing in transformers up to 50 MVA and 132 kV class.

capital_allocation_philosophy.narrative: Management has a debt-free balance sheet and funds growth through internal accruals.

execution_track_record.narrative: Management has successfully expanded capacity and delivered revenue and profit growth.

forward_guidance.narrative: Management targets FY27 revenue of ₹800–900 Cr.

communication_transparency.narrative: Management has been clear about growth drivers and expansion plans.

governance_and_board.narrative: Management has no major governance controversies.

promoter_skin_in_game.narrative: Management is family-led with a history of execution.
